name: Cec Spence Memorial UNE Country Scholarship
summary: Scholarship for high-achieving regional or remote school leavers in financial need starting a full-time UNE bachelor degree.
key: $1,250 per 6 credit points (or equivalent) to a maximum of $10,000.
who: Year 12 school leaver or 1 to 2 year gap-year student
ATAR or equivalent of at least 86.3
Permanent home address in a regional or remote area
how: Complete the application form, including the Financial Need Details section
catches: The 2026 round closed 4 January 2026; check the page for the next round

source.label: University of New England: Cec Spence Memorial UNE Country Scholarships

evidence.quote: The student shall receive $1,250 per 6 credit points (or equivalent) to a maximum of $10,000
The applicant's permanent home address is in a Regional or Remote area
Students must have achieved an ATAR/UAC ranking or equivalent mark of at least 86.3
Applications are no longer being accepted for this scholarship
